verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੬ : ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਰੇ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਹੈ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 16 : vaahiguroo pare to(n) pare hai

en.bdb: Waheguru, the wondrous Lord is beond all limits

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਹਿਮਾ ਮਹਿ ਮਹਿਕਾਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਲਖ ਨ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਜਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: mahimaa meh mahikaar vich mahimaa lakh na mahimaa jaanai|

en.bdb: Even the people spreading the fragrance of His grandeur don’t understand the real nature of His greatness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਮਹਾਤਮ ਮਹਾਤਮਾ ਤਿਲ ਨ ਮਹਾਤਮੁ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: lakh mahaatam mahaatamaa til na mahaatam aakh vakhaanai|

en.bdb: Lakhs of saint explain the gist and significance of that Lord but even all joined could not put forth even a fraction of His grandeur.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਖ ਉਸਤਤੀ ਪਲ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਹੈਰਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: ausatat vich lakh usatatee pal usatat a(n)dhar hairaanai|

en.bdb: Myriad eulogists are wonder struck (because they could not eulogise Him properly)

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਚਰਜ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਖ ਅਚਰਜਾ ਅਚਰਜ ਅਚਰਜ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: acharaj vich lakh acharajaa acharaj acharaj choj viddaanai|

en.bdb: Millions of wonders are full of wonder and they are further surprised to see the awe-inspiring feats of the Lord, the all wonder Himself.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਮਾਦੀ ਵਿਸਮਾਦ ਲਖ ਵਿਸਮਾਦਹੁ ਵਿਸਮਾਦ ਵਿਹਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: visamaadhee visamaadh lakh visamaadhahu visamaadh vihaanai|

en.bdb: Looking at the completeness of the wonder of that wondrous Lord, the elation feels elated and exhausted.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਬਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਮ ਹੈ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਆਖਾਣ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: abagat gat at agam hai akath kathaa aakhaan vakhaanai|

en.bdb: The dynamism of that unmanifest Lord is extremely unapproachable and even a shirt account of His grand story is ineffable.
His measurement is beyond lacs of measures.
